text:
runtime-mike: Deploybot kicked off canary for tenant-shadow-index migration, canary 12/50. Hold flagged: long table lock observed on write-03. tagging @sre-kai @devops-jen

deploybot: Deploybot: Canary progress 12/50. Hold reason: `row_lock_wait_time > 30s` on db-write-03. Manual review required. To continue: `!deploy override canary 7065432100` (admins only).

devops-jen: Looking at metrics — pg_rw_locks spike on write-03, backfill throughput dropped. Can we scale the replica or drop batch size?

maria: Batch size was bumped in last commit. Rolling back batch-size change would help but needs a new release. Not ideal mid-window.

sre-kai: Recommend manual hold. We can pin previous migration variant for the canary to avoid re-running the heavier backfill. Suggest `pin-migration v2.3.1` for canary group.

runtime-mike: If we pin, need to update release notes and alert PMs. PM notified? @product-aria

product-aria: Got it. If we pin, I will add a short note to release notes and prepare a rollback playbook.

devops-jen: Alternative: route canary to a less-loaded shard (shard-8) with `!deploy route shard-8` — lower risk and avoids redoing backfill on write-03.

maria: Can someone run quick sanity queries? `SELECT count(*) FROM shadow_index WHERE migrated = false LIMIT 1;`

runtime-mike: I ran it: ~24k rows remain, backfill rate ~400/s on write-03, expected ~2k/s normally. Looks like IO contention.

sre-kai: Manual hold then. @deploy-leads please issue `!deploy hold` and don't override until we either revert batch-size or route the canary. I'll open a short incident ticket for the DB team.

deploybot: Deploybot: Canary for migration tenant-shadow-index PAUSED by manual hold. Action required: owners to ack and provide next step. Use `!deploy resume` when safe.

runtime-mike: :thumbsup: ack. I'll file a quick PR to pin canary to v2.3.1 and ping for approvals.

devops-jen: Note: pin + re-run will stretch the change window by ~30m. Is that acceptable?

product-aria: We have a 1h window. +30m looks doable if we get signoff from release manager and SRE. I'll coordinate with stakeholders.

maria: I'll revert the batch-size change in staging and run a dry-run to confirm improvement. ETA 15m.

runtime-mike: Thanks. Keep posting updates here. If no update in 20m we'll escalate to release manager @release-omar.

release-omar: Oncall noted, standing by for decision and ready to sign off on window extension.
